_comment: Decoded from GameMaker 8.1 lib/*.lib by black-box analysis. Summaries are paraphrased; list/hint template text is intentionally omitted (only the placeholder tokens used are listed). See specs/file-formats.md section "Action libraries".

actions.name: Move
actions.summary: Start moving in one of the selected directions (or stop) at the given speed; arg0 is a 9-char 0/1 mask in numeric-keypad order (0=down-left .. 4=stop .. 8=up-right), one set entry chosen at random.

actions.name: Set_Motion
actions.summary: Set motion to a given direction (degrees) and speed.

actions.name: Move_Point
actions.summary: Start moving towards a point at a given speed.

actions.name: Set_Hspeed
actions.summary: Set horizontal speed.

actions.name: Set_Vspeed
actions.summary: Set vertical speed.

actions.name: Set_Gravity
actions.summary: Set gravity strength and its direction.

actions.name: Reverse_Xdir
actions.summary: Negate horizontal speed.

actions.name: Reverse_Ydir
actions.summary: Negate vertical speed.

actions.name: Set_Friction
actions.summary: Set friction.

actions.name: Move_To
actions.summary: Teleport the instance to a position.

actions.name: Move_Start
actions.summary: Teleport the instance back to its starting position.

actions.name: Move_Random
actions.summary: Teleport to a random collision-free position, optionally snapped to a grid.

actions.name: Snap
actions.summary: Snap the position to a grid of the given cell size.

actions.name: Wrap
actions.summary: When outside the room, wrap position to the opposite side (horizontally, vertically or both).

actions.name: Move_Contact
actions.summary: Move in a direction up to a maximum distance until touching solid (or any) instances.

actions.name: Bounce
actions.summary: Reverse motion against solid (or all) instances, optionally precisely.

actions.name: Path
actions.summary: Start following a path with speed, end behaviour and absolute/relative placement.

actions.name: Path_End
actions.summary: Stop following the current path.

actions.name: Path_Position
actions.summary: Set the position (0..1) along the current path.

actions.name: Path_Speed
actions.summary: Set the speed along the current path.

actions.name: Step_Linear
actions.summary: Take one straight-line step towards a point, optionally stopping at solid/any instances.

actions.name: Step_Potential
actions.summary: Take one step towards a point using simple potential-field obstacle avoidance.

actions.name: Create_Object
actions.summary: Create an instance of an object at a position.

actions.name: Create_Object_Motion
actions.summary: Create an instance of an object at a position and give it a speed and direction.

actions.name: Create_Object_Random
actions.summary: Create an instance of one of up to four objects chosen at random at a position.

actions.name: Change_Object
actions.summary: Turn the instance into another object, optionally running destroy/create events.

actions.name: Kill_Object
actions.summary: Destroy the instance.

actions.name: Kill_Position
actions.summary: Destroy all instances whose bounding box contains a position.

actions.name: Set_Sprite
actions.summary: Set sprite, sub-image (-1 keeps current) and image speed.

actions.name: Transform_Sprite
actions.summary: Set sprite x/y scale, rotation angle and mirroring/flipping.

actions.name: Color_Sprite
actions.summary: Set sprite blend colour and alpha.

actions.name: Set_Sprite_Old
actions.summary: Legacy: set sprite with a scale factor (hidden in the palette).

actions.name: Begin_Sound
actions.summary: Play a sound, optionally looping.

actions.name: End_Sound
actions.summary: Stop a sound.

actions.name: If_Sound
actions.summary: Question: is the given sound playing?

actions.name: Previous_Room
actions.summary: Go to the previous room in room order, with a transition.

actions.name: Next_Room
actions.summary: Go to the next room in room order, with a transition.

actions.name: Current_Room
actions.summary: Restart the current room, with a transition.

actions.name: Another_Room
actions.summary: Go to a specific room, with a transition.

actions.name: If_Previous_Room
actions.summary: Question: does a previous room exist?

actions.name: If_Next_Room
actions.summary: Question: does a next room exist?

actions.name: Set_Alarm
actions.summary: Set one of the 12 alarm clocks to a number of steps.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.summary: Pause the game for some milliseconds, optionally redrawing first.

actions.name: Set TimeLine (OLD)
actions.summary: Legacy: assign a time line and position (hidden).

actions.name: Set TimeLine
actions.summary: Assign a time line, its start position, whether to start now and whether to loop.

actions.name: Position TimeLine
actions.summary: Set the current time line position.

actions.name: Speed TimeLine
actions.summary: Set the current time line speed.

actions.name: Start TimeLine
actions.summary: Start or resume the assigned time line.

actions.name: Pause TimeLine
actions.summary: Pause the assigned time line.

actions.name: Stop TimeLine
actions.summary: Stop the time line and reset its position.

actions.name: Message
actions.summary: Show a modal message box.

actions.name: Show_Info
actions.summary: Show the game information window.

actions.name: Show_Video
actions.summary: Legacy: play a video file (hidden).

actions.name: Splash_Text
actions.summary: Splash a text file.

actions.name: Splash_Image
actions.summary: Splash an image file.

actions.name: Splash_Web
actions.summary: Splash a web page in the game window or the browser.

actions.name: Splash_Video
actions.summary: Splash a video file, optionally looping.

actions.name: Splash_Settings
actions.summary: Configure splash window caption, placement, close button and close-on-escape/mouse.

actions.name: Restart_Game
actions.summary: Restart the game.

actions.name: End_Game
actions.summary: End the game.

actions.name: Save_Game
actions.summary: Save the game state to a file.

actions.name: Load_Game
actions.summary: Load the game state from a file.

actions.name: Replace_Sprite
actions.summary: Replace a sprite's images from a file (with given number of sub-images).

actions.name: Replace_Sound
actions.summary: Replace a sound's data from a file.

actions.name: Replace_Background
actions.summary: Replace a background's image from a file.

actions.name: If_Empty
actions.summary: Question: is a position free of solid (or all) instances?

actions.name: If Collision
actions.summary: Question: is there a collision with solid (or all) instances at a position?

actions.name: If_Object
actions.summary: Question: is there an instance of an object at a position?

actions.name: If_Number
actions.summary: Question: compare the instance count of an object with a number.

actions.name: If_Dice
actions.summary: Question: true with probability 1/sides.

actions.name: If_Question
actions.summary: Question: ask the player a yes/no question.

actions.name: If
actions.summary: Question: evaluate an expression as a condition.

actions.name: If_Mouse
actions.summary: Question: is a mouse button (or no button) currently pressed?

actions.name: If_Aligned
actions.summary: Question: is the instance position aligned to a grid?

actions.name: Start_Block
actions.summary: Begin a block of actions.

actions.name: Else
actions.summary: Else branch for the preceding question.

actions.name: Exit
actions.summary: Exit the current event.

actions.name: End_Block
actions.summary: End a block of actions.

actions.name: Repeat
actions.summary: Repeat the next action or block a number of times.

actions.name: Inherited
actions.summary: Run the same event of the parent object.

actions.name: Code
actions.summary: Execute a GML code fragment (argument 0 holds the code).

actions.name: Execute_Script
actions.summary: Call a script with up to five arguments.

actions.name: Comment
actions.summary: Comment; does nothing at run time.

actions.name: Variable
actions.summary: Assign (or add to, when relative) a variable.

actions.name: If_Variable
actions.summary: Question: compare a variable with a value.

actions.name: Draw_Variable
actions.summary: Draw the value of a variable at a position.

actions.name: Set_Score
actions.summary: Set (or add to) the score.

actions.name: If_Score
actions.summary: Question: compare the score with a value.

actions.name: Draw_Score
actions.summary: Draw the score with a caption at a position.

actions.name: Highscore_Show
actions.summary: Show the highscore table with background, border, colours and font.

actions.name: Highscore_Clear
actions.summary: Clear the highscore table.

actions.name: Set_Life
actions.summary: Set (or add to) the number of lives.

actions.name: If_Life
actions.summary: Question: compare lives with a value.

actions.name: Draw_Life
actions.summary: Draw the number of lives with a caption.

actions.name: Draw_Life_Images
actions.summary: Draw the lives as repeated images of a sprite.

actions.name: Set_Health
actions.summary: Set (or add to) health (0-100).

actions.name: If_Health
actions.summary: Question: compare health with a value.

actions.name: Draw_Health
actions.summary: Draw a health bar in a rectangle with back and bar colours.

actions.name: Set_Caption
actions.summary: Choose which of score/lives/health are shown in the window caption and their captions.

actions.name: Part_Syst_Create
actions.summary: Create the particle system at a drawing depth.

actions.name: Part_Syst_Destroy
actions.summary: Destroy the particle system.

actions.name: Part_Syst_Clear
actions.summary: Remove all particles from the system.

actions.name: Part_Type_Create_Old
actions.summary: Legacy: define a particle type (hidden).

actions.name: Part_Type_Create
actions.summary: Define a particle type: shape or sprite and size range.

actions.name: Part_Type_Color
actions.summary: Set particle type colour (mixed or changing) and start/end alpha.

actions.name: Part_Type_Life
actions.summary: Set particle type life range.

actions.name: Part_Type_Speed
actions.summary: Set particle type speed range, direction range and friction.

actions.name: Part_Type_Gravity
actions.summary: Set particle type gravity amount and direction.

actions.name: Part_Type_Secondary
actions.summary: Set secondary particles spawned each step and on death.

actions.name: Part_Emit_Create
actions.summary: Create an emitter with a shape and region.

actions.name: Part_Emit_Destroy
actions.summary: Destroy an emitter.

actions.name: Part_Emit_Burst
actions.summary: Burst a number of particles of a type from an emitter.

actions.name: Part_Emit_Stream
actions.summary: Continuously stream particles of a type from an emitter.

actions.name: CD_Play
actions.summary: Play CD audio tracks.

actions.name: CD_Stop
actions.summary: Stop CD audio.

actions.name: CD_Pause
actions.summary: Pause CD audio.

actions.name: CD_Resume
actions.summary: Resume CD audio.

actions.name: CD_If_Exists
actions.summary: Question: is there a CD in the drive?

actions.name: CD_If_Playing
actions.summary: Question: is the CD playing?

actions.name: Set_Mouse
actions.summary: Replace the mouse cursor with a sprite and/or hide the system cursor.

actions.name: Open_Webpage
actions.summary: Open a web page in the default browser (hidden).

actions.name: Draw_Sprite
actions.summary: Draw a sprite sub-image at a position (-1 = current image).

actions.name: Draw_Background
actions.summary: Draw a background at a position, optionally tiled.

actions.name: Draw_Text
actions.summary: Draw text at a position.

actions.name: Draw_Text_Scaled
actions.summary: Draw text with scaling and rotation.

actions.name: Draw_Rectangle
actions.summary: Draw a filled or outlined rectangle.

actions.name: Draw_Gradient_Hor
actions.summary: Draw a rectangle filled with a horizontal colour gradient.

actions.name: Draw_Gradient_Vert
actions.summary: Draw a rectangle filled with a vertical colour gradient.

actions.name: Draw_Ellipse
actions.summary: Draw a filled or outlined ellipse.

actions.name: Draw_Ellipse_Gradient
actions.summary: Draw an ellipse filled with a centre-to-edge colour gradient.

actions.name: Draw_Line
actions.summary: Draw a line.

actions.name: Draw_Arrow
actions.summary: Draw an arrow with a given tip size.

actions.name: Set_Color
actions.summary: Set the drawing colour.

actions.name: Set_Font
actions.summary: Set the drawing font and horizontal alignment.

actions.name: Fullscreen
actions.summary: Switch, or set, windowed/full-screen mode.

actions.name: Take_Snapshot
actions.summary: Save a screenshot to a file.

actions.name: Effect
actions.summary: Create a built-in visual effect of a type, size and colour, below or above objects.
